english: Monsters really suit the dark, huh...
Oh, the Megumi chief. Night patrol?
Yeah. Arsonist rumors... Wait! You lot...!
Off to my part-time job. Popular girls have it rough...
Don't want that. Give me something edible.
I said we don't want it!
Celebrities enjoy nightlife too.\fPrivate time. No autographs.
No more business? Can I go?
Can't give you my schedule. Autograph next time...
Otsu! Where to at this hour?!
Shameful for the Earth Defense Force! Men grow through battle!
Too bad... I'll take you on whenever you feel like it.
Hahaha! Wash your Gin Tama and try again!
Oh, good timing... Sorry, but some cash...
We have no money to lend you!
Ahh... Want to go out, but no money...\fGuess I'll go see sis...
Gin, you should take those words to heart too.
Oh, Jump! Need to buy mine...!
Busy. Don't talk. Need to go buy Jump.
Leave him, Shinpachi. Deep in thought, maybe.
I said leave him. Must have his reasons!
Here we are. Let's go inside.
Relax. Got plenty of Gin Tama.
...Now you mention it, maybe not enough...
No! We don't know what'll happen inside, right?
Enough Gin Tama? If not, we should get some more...
Let's gather Gin Tama, just in case.
Gin, really ready? Enough Gin Tama?
Tell me right away if anything happens.
No, not back here yet...\fDid something happen to the commander?
Better to prevent trouble before it starts, right?
No information on the Joi rebels yet today...
A new dish? How's that a case?
It's just news... What a fuss.
All right, all right... I'll try it next time.
I rather regret talking to you.
What?! For ordinary folks, it IS big news!
Eat properly! You'll never grow otherwise!
You MUST try it! You'll regret it if you don't!
Not Daikichi. Not a restaurant either.
I'm in a hurry! Ask someone else!
Was that it...? So, who am I?
What kind of case is it?
Have a bite at my shop.
Can't fight on an empty stomach, right?
We're in a hurry. No time to talk!
Don't need you to tell me...
Yes, I'm bad at sports...\fThat's why I play recorder!\fI'd dance too if I were athletic!
I get it. Don't make a fuss.
In a hurry! Tell me later!
I can SEE that! I'm asking why there's so many of you!
Probably a mistake... I'll look anyway.
Where'd you see this gorilla-like guy?
Not arresting him... Bringing him back.
No! Not a gorilla. The Shinsengumi commander.
No, a person. Not a gorilla. I'm busy. Explain later.
Then maybe it escaped from a zoo.
Hey, let me join the Shinsengumi!
Wanted to join the Shinsengumi when I grew up... Never mind.
Don't want a gorilla for a boss...
I DO want to join when I grow up after all.
What's going on? What's all the fuss?
Never seen a pompadour jutting forward at forty-five degrees.
Dream pitcher!\fOops... Why throw dreams?\fDream catcher!
Um... I'd like to change jobs...
Dango shop after all... Quickest way there?
Maybe I saw a gorilla, not your commander.
Even I'm surprised he got mistaken for THAT...
I'm in a hurry! No time for this!
